name: @pipeworx/mcp-denue

tools.name: denue_search_nearby
tools.description: Find businesses near a coordinate. Returns establishments matching the keyword within the given radius (max 5000m).

condition.description: Search keyword — business name, brand, or activity (e.g., "oxxo", "cafe", "farmacia"). Use "todos" for all establishments in radius.

tools.name: denue_search_by_name
tools.description: Search businesses by name or brand across Mexico or a single state. Paginated — set page_size and page_start to walk results.

state_code.description: Two-digit state code "01"-"32", or "00" for all Mexico. Default "00".

page_end.description: Last record (default page_start + 24, max ~1000 per request)

tools.name: denue_search_in_state
tools.description: Search businesses in a single Mexican state by keyword — matches against name, activity, or address. Use this for state-scoped queries that need more than just business name (e.g., "panaderia", "ferreteria"). Returns paginated results.

keyword.description: Search term — matches name, economic activity description, or address text.

state_code.description: Two-digit state code "01"-"32" (required — use denue_search_by_name with "00" for nationwide).

tools.name: denue_establishment
tools.description: Get full details for a single establishment by DENUE ID (the "Id" field from search results).

tools.name: denue_count
tools.description: Count establishments by economic activity + geography + size stratum. Returns totals — no detail records. Use for market-sizing questions like "how many pharmacies are in Jalisco".

activity_code.description: SCIAN economic activity code(s), comma-separated. 2-6 digits (sector → branch → class). Use "0" for any activity. Examples: "46" (retail), "722" (food services), "464111" (pharmacies).

area_code.description: Geography code(s), comma-separated. "00" = all Mexico; 2 digits = state; 5 digits = municipality (state+mun). Examples: "09" (CDMX), "14039" (Guadalajara).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-denue forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the denue pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
